content: @react-pdf/renderer v4.5.1 (April 2026): PDFDownloadLink requires dynamic() import with ssr:false in Next.js to prevent build-time SSR errors. Since Next.js 14.1.1+ the crash bug is fixed but PDFDownloadLink still needs client-only execution. Pattern: const PDFDownloadLink = dynamic(() => import('@react-pdf/renderer').then(mod => mod.PDFDownloadLink), { ssr: false }). Document structure: <Document><Page size='A4'><View><Text>...</Text></View></Page></Document>. Built-in fonts include Helvetica (no external fetch). StyleSheet.create() for styles. PDFDownloadLink children can be render prop: {({ loading }) => loading ? 'Preparing...' : 'Download'}. React 19 supported since v4.1.0.
